title: Mistral vibe: pyasn1 has quadratic CPU consumption in constructed BIT STRING decoding (CVE-2026-119196)
description: pyasn1 versions through 0.6.4 have a vulnerability in decoding constructed BIT STRING values where CPU consumption grows quadratically with input size due to repeated shifting and copying during decoding. This can lead to CPU exhaustion and denial of service when processing attacker-controlled ASN.1 data. The issue affects BER and CER decoders and certain schema-driven DER decoding paths. No confidentiality or integrity impact is reported. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 7.5, indicating high severity.
